code_blocks.content:
FAQ Gap Sprint Board

Find answerable FAQs before the page gets bloated.

Type a service or topic, add the audience, generate likely FAQ opportunities, then sort each card into Answer Now, Needs Proof, or Skip. Everything runs offline in this one file.

Tip: edit the questions directly. Use the lane buttons on each card to clean up the brief fast.

0 Answer Now
0 Needs Proof
0 Skip
